title: Interpreter runs in the capture wrapper
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $c$ be a configuration of the four-tape interpreter on input $x$. For any assignment of contents and head positions to the $M$ work tapes and any $t\in\mathbb{N}$, running the capture wrapper of $M$ with the fixed universal interpreter for $t$ steps from the right-block embedding of $c$ yields the right-block embedding of the interpreter’s $t$-step run, with those assigned tape contents and head positions retained.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state machine over the Boolean alphabet
$c$ is a four-tape interpreter configuration on $x$
Arbitrary contents and head positions are assigned to the $M$ work tapes
replaced:
Let $M$ be a finite-tape machine over $\{0,1\}$.  For every four-tape
configuration of the table interpreter, every assignment of contents and head
positions to $M$'s work tapes, and every number of steps $t$: running the
combined capture machine (which pairs $M$ with the fixed table interpreter)
for $t$ steps from the right-block embedding of the interpreter configuration
equals the right-block embedding of the interpreter's own $t$-step run, with
the inactive tapes and heads unchanged.
